name: Plain text that looks like markdown
description: The user types characters that markdown uses: stars, underscores, backticks, brackets, &, <, >. The editor must escape them so they come back as the same text, and must not add or remove backslashes on the second save.
descriptionHtml:
The user types characters that markdown uses: stars, underscores, backticks, brackets, &, <, >. The editor must escape them so they come back as the same text, and must not add or remove backslashes on the second save.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Form.RichTextOnFormTest#syntaxText into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
